Name: Kayla Peterman
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I believe the strategy "Take a Line for a Walk" will work best in my classroom. I believe I can take a page for our current text and instruct the students to find a line that they connect with most. I am hoping this helps my students to uncover the theme of the story we are reading as well as make a personal connection to what we are reading.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I have used the "Around the Table" writing approach where I had the students do a free write about a specific topic or image. Once they write for two minutes, I have them pass their notebooks around the people at their table. While a lot of students took this very serious, I found that some students starting getting majorly off topic and was essentially just passing notes back and forth.
